monument_title: 1491 Krakow Horologion of Schweipolt Fiol (Часослов Швайпольта Фіоля, Краків, 1491)

bottleneck_causes: Colometric reconstruction of Tone 6 Acrostic Penitential Canon unto Our Lord Jesus ('Очию моею плачь прийди', Odes 1-6 on p574-p579)
Diplomatic heraldic description and historical apparatus for the 1491 Krakow woodcut arms ('herb Krakowa' + Fiol monogram) and King Casimir IV colophon on leaf p580
High apparatus density (97 footnotes, 2,958 words = 1.74x body length) plus internal subagent gate pre-check
Cold-start decipherment of ornamental woodcut headpiece and interwoven Cyrillic vyaz ('в'язь') display title on leaf p2
Establishing the 8-Tone Midnight Office Triadika ('Троичны') and Matins Photagogica ('Свѣтилна') structural paradigm (p2-p10)
Internal subagent Small Pause Gate pre-flight failure and self-repair loop prior to yielding turn (logged in triage_inbox.jsonl at 12:17:56Z)
Highest total word output in the monument (6,245 words: 2,134 body + 4,111 footnote words)

Extreme apparatus density (141 footnotes = 14.1 notes/leaf) across clipped Polyeleos Selected Psalm verses ('Припѣвы') and Festal Megalynaria ('Величанія', p557-p560) requiring individual LXX/Masoretic citations
Internal subagent gate verification run prior to completion

patterns_observed: for ever and ever -> unto ages of ages
lowercase he/him/his/thou/thee/thy in subordinate psalm clauses
the priest shall -> active present indicative
Leaf p55 (Cohort 6): '# THE ORDER OF THE TYPIKA, WHICH IS THE OBEDNITSA' rejected due to leading 'THE '
Leaf p529 (Cohort 53): '# SELECTED PSALMS FOR SOLEMN COMMEMORATIONS AND FEASTS OF THE LORD[^864]' rejected due to missing 'PART N:' prefix
3rd-person -eth verbs (hath, doth, shineth, granteth) in hymn body and footnotes.txt not covered by Phase 1's 13-verb eth_map
Square-bracketed Cyrillic incipits in rubrics: [Всемирная радость] (c17:L3), [Крест начертав] (c17:L11, c18:L59)
Greek liturgical exclamation with Cyrillic homoglyphs in square brackets: [κελεύсате] (c44:L15, L18)
Square-bracketed Cyrillic marginal pen trials on rear flyleaf p581: [ѿ а в г д], [дєду • Бойсько • корну • рокъ], [филипыкъ дѣ҃ • съвѧ...], [свѧтаа троица] (c59:L14-20)
anomalies_by_category.healed_by: Targeted regex replacement ([...Cyrillic...] -> (*...*)) prior to final --compile-publication pass

missed_false_negative_cruxes.anomaly: Historical quire lacuna jumping from Feb 5 (St. Agatha) to May 7 (Apparition of the Cross) on a single page
Physical binding transposition of Folio 210 between July 24 (St. Christina / Sts. Boris & Gleb) and July 25 (Dormition of St. Anna)

recommended_calibration.dense_polyglot_apparatus_footnote_thresh: Increase from >= 5 to >= 12 footnotes/leaf (or count only notes > 220 chars)
recommended_calibration.borderline_sgc02_ratio_upper_bound: Increase from 2.20 to 2.65 for abbreviated Church Slavonic rubrical compendia
recommended_calibration.codicological_keyword_trigger: Queue any leaf whose body or footnotes match \b(lacuna|missing\s+quire|transpos(ed|ition)|misbound|foliation\s+jump|colophon|autograph|pen\s+trial)\b

dimension_4_compiler_and_monument_edge_c.description: Global whitelisting of '# TONE N' and '# EXAPOSTILARIA' (designed for Octoechoi) alongside rejection of '# THE ORDER OF THE TYPIKA...' (p55) and '# SELECTED PSALMS...' (p529) caused Part 2 ('exapostilaria-of-the-week.md', 204 KB) to absorb the entire Daily Office (p7-p122) and Part 4 ('part-iii-menologion.md', 978 KB) to absorb the Menologion, Triodion, Passion Week, Pentecostarion, Selected Psalms, and Megalynaria (p141-p563).

Dynamic H1 extraction did not strip '[^N]' footnote markers from h1_title ('PART IV: RULE FOR HOLY COMMUNION[^1205]') and truncated slug at 40 chars with .strip('_') instead of .strip('-_'), producing trailing hyphens ('...arms-.md') and mid-word cuts ('...marg.md').

While 3 mid-sentence page breaks were stitched, leaf boundaries where the subagent placed a trailing footnote '[^N]' at the bottom of leaf pK or a leading '...word' ellipsis at the top of leaf p(K+1) remained unmerged.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Strip Footnote Markers & Fix Hyphen Truncation in Dynamic H1 Part Slicing
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Eliminates raw '[^N]' markers in codex_registry.json Part titles/handoff notes and prevents trailing hyphens ('...arms-.md') and mid-word filename cuts.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Auto-Parenthesize Square-Bracketed Cyrillic & Sanitize Greek/Cyrillic Homoglyphs
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Eliminates 100% of Phase 2 Gate 5A failures caused by '[...Cyrillic...]' brackets in rubrics/marginalia and Greek words contaminated by Cyrillic homoglyphs ('[κελεύсате]').

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Genre-Scoped H1 Landmarks for Horologion / Compendium Codices
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Prevents Octoechos-specific '# TONE N' / '# EXAPOSTILARIA' H1 landmarks from hijacking Horologion Part slicing and allows '# (THE) ORDER OF...', '# TRIODION', '# PENTECOSTARION', and '# SELECTED PSALMS' to slice modular Parts cleanly.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Recalibrate argon_review_queue.json Thresholds & Add Codicological Anomaly Keywords
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Reduces false-positive Argon queue noise from 95.9% (70/73 leaves) to <10% by raising footnote count threshold from >=5 to >=12 and upper SGC-02 ratio from 2.20 to 2.65, while adding keyword triggers for genuine physical lacunae and folio transpositions.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Unify Phase 1 & Phase 2 '-eth' Verb Healing and Suppress Pre-Heal Triage Noise
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Applies the full 120-verb morphological '-eth' healer to both body and footnotes during Phase 1 and logs to scratch/triage_inbox.jsonl only when deterministic self-healing fails.
